title: Predicted UFO hovers over Puharich family gathering

tellings.quote: like him, that Puharich's son and two or three of the cousins all saw this huge thing. It silently hovered over.

plain: In the late 1980s, after Andrija 'Andy' Puharich predicted it, a huge object hovered silently over a Puharich family gathering in North Carolina, and Puharich's son and 'two or three of the cousins all saw this huge thing.' The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels this from what one of Puharich's cousins told him, with a family video among his sources. Puharich was a scientist the episode links to the CIA who claimed contact with a council of alien beings. If true, he could make a sighting happen when he said it would.
